headline: 2 vehicles left and none arrived between Day A and Day B; the camera could not see for 1 min 38 s.

bullets.text: 2 vehicles parked on Day A were gone on Day B.
Most visitors near one parked car: 7 came close (3 cars, 3 people and 1 truck) between 00:00 and 02:35.
In total 45 cars, 9 people and 6 trucks moved through the view; 69 tracks were parked vehicles.
Busiest route: 16 vehicles went bottom left to top right.
Busiest moment: 18 vehicles on screen at 03:58.

honesty: The camera could not see for 1 min 38 s in total, in 2 stretches (1 min 32 s view blocked, 4 s blurry picture and 2 s no picture); the longest was 02:36 to 04:12. Anything that happened then is unknown.
SIMULATED: Day A / Day B are two halves of one 5-minute clip.
25 parked vehicles could not be compared between the two days (11 because: vehicle is cut off by the edge of day B's frame or outside day A's view).
Counts come from an automatic detector; one person or car can be counted twice if it was lost and found again.
138 more tracks hardly moved (less than their own width) and are not counted as going by.
'Came close' only means near: 40 of the 40 parked vehicles checked had someone or something close by, which says nothing about who did anything.
"Busiest moment" at 03:58 falls in a stretch when the camera could not see well (blurry picture), so treat it with care.
